name: pdf-viewer
title: PDF Viewer
description: A PDF in a viewer. With the app's rendered pages (e.g. PDF.js's canvas and text layer): a rail of the pages, the pages one under another, page by page, zoom with Fit to the width, and a find bar (Ctrl or Cmd+F) that marks what it finds in the pages' text with the CSS Custom Highlight API, no elements added. With only a file: the browser's own PDF viewer in a frame, told the page and zoom by its address.
